About

PHDecorating has one aim and that is to provide a first class service to our clients with respect to high standard of work that we produce and the top quality products used on each project. The vast majority of our bookings are by recommendation. We take on all types of jobs from small domestic work to large interior projects, all carried out to the highest standards, and at competitive prices.

We provide interior decorating services including the fitting of skirting boards and covings as well as light maintenance and joinery.

PHDecorating is based on Queens Road in Hale and operates on a wide radius including South Manchester, Stockport, Wilmslow, Sandbach ,Knutsford, Lymm, Urmston, Flixton Chorlton, Didsbury and anywhere in between.
